title: Model Card
description: A card describing an artist adapter: who consented, what it was trained on, and which base model it extends.

schema_version.description: Schema version. 1.1.0 adds the optional watermarking-v2 fields; both versions validate so files can sync between machines mid-migration.

artist_name.description: Human-readable name of the artist the adapter represents.

artist_id.description: Stable unique identifier for the artist.

consent_statement.description: Plain-language statement recording the artist's consent to train this adapter.

training_catalogue.description: The tracks the adapter was trained on.

duration.description: Duration of the track in seconds.

vocal.description: True if the track has sung vocals, false if instrumental. Optional — cards written before khaos-attribution 0.4.1 predate this field.

training_date.description: Date the adapter was trained, as an ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD).

adapter_version.description: Version of the adapter this card describes.

base_model.description: Name and version of the base model the adapter was trained against.

base_model_licence.description: Licence under which the base model is distributed.

credit_line.description: How the artist is credited on outputs — presentation only, never a rights claim.

phonogram_notice.description: The ℗ notice (sound recordings — what the adapter trains on).

consent.description: Structured consent behind the human-readable statement: who, in what capacity, to what scope, when, under which wording version.

watermark_id.description: The run's AudioSeal codeword (watermarking v2): every output of this adapter embeds this ID. Optional on pre-v2 cards; required for new runs by the trainer.

base_model_id.description: The base model as an identifier, <engine>@<variant>, beside the human name in base_model.

engine_commit.description: The engine code's commit or weights revision that trained (card) or rendered (record) this; null when not a checkout.
